text:
Chip ’N' Dale scurry around The Magic of Disney Animation 🤎 #HollywoodStudios
The Magic of Disney Animation is now open at Disney’s Hollywood Studios. https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/attractions/hollywood-studios/magic-of-disney-animation/ 

Celebrate the grand opening with an unforgettable gathering of 60 Disney Parks characters! Inspired by Disney's beloved Once Upon a Studio short film, this special Disney Parks recreation brings together iconic Disney characters, rare character appearances, and fan favorites for one magical moment. Watch as characters from across Disney stories come together to welcome an all-new attraction dedicated to the wonder, creativity, and legacy of Disney Animation.

text:
Bakari recently visited the vet hospital for a routine wellness check-up! 🦍 #AnimalKingdom
A new chapter has begun on Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail at Disney’s Animal Kingdom Theme Park, where Bakari, a 21-year-old male western lowland gorilla, is gradually settling into his new home and role as the leader of the park’s family troop.

This work is part of Disney’s ongoing commitment to exceptional animal care and is supported by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums’ (AZA) Species Survival Plan (SSP), which helps maintain strong, genetically diverse populations of western lowland gorillas in managed care. 

Bakari’s arrival also highlights the care, expertise, and science led by Disney’s animal care team to help protect this critically endangered species. Each step forward supports not only the wellbeing of the gorillas at Walt Disney World, but also broader conservation efforts to help gorillas thrive in the wild.

Check out this video showing a peek at Bakari's routine wellness check-up.
